subject: Request: MFA enrollment export + short-lived session token traces for SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Kimberly Nguyen <k.nguyen@aureliahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@aureliahealth.com
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MFA enrollment export + short-lived session token traces for SOC 2 review

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking our SOC 2 evidence request. As part of our auditor's requests for Aurelia Health's vendor SOC 2 review, they asked for a couple of items beyond the Type II report:

- A CSV export of user MFA device enrollment (all enrolled devices in the audit window: 2025-09-01 to 2026-02-28) with fields: user_email, device_type, enrollment_method, enrolled_at, last_used_at.
- A time-limited extract (NDJSON preferred) of authentication session tokens/headers for ephemeral sessions during the same window — specifically tokens with TTL <= 1 hour and any refresh events. Auditors want to verify that short-lived session semantics are enforced for service-to-service keys and delegated tokens.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these artifacts (redacted to avoid PII where needed) and if you can also provide a short statement that the token TTL policy and device attestation requirements were enforced during that period?

If you have a standard bridge letter that covers "supplemental authentication traces and device enrollment exports" we can include that alongside the SOC 2 report. Auditor contact is Jason Cole (jason.cole@auditpartners.net) if you prefer to coordinate directly.

Thanks — we need to turn this around in about 7 business days.

Best,
Kim
Kimberly Nguyen
Senior Information Security Manager
Aurelia Health

---
Attachments: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Nguyen <k.nguyen@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MFA enrollment export + short-lived session token traces for SOC 2 review

Thanks Kim — looping in Laura (compliance lead) and Markus (platform infra) to scope this. Quick initial responses:

- We can produce an MFA enrollment export scoped to the audit window. We will sanitize user identifiers to the level you prefer (full email vs hashed). Please confirm which is acceptable for your auditors.
- We can generate a token/session trace extract for tokens with TTL <= 1 hour, and include refresh events. That extract will come from our auth proxy logs and will include token IDs, issuance timestamps, TTL, associated client_id/service_account, and refresh events.

Open question: do auditors need raw headers (we should redact IPs if needed) or a structured export? NDJSON with a schema mapping is our preferred deliverable.

Action items for us: Markus — can you confirm feasibility and estimated delivery (CSV + NDJSON + a short attestation paragraph / bridge letter draft)?

Kim — would Aurelia accept masked emails (e.g., j***@aureliahealth.com) and a mapping file if needed under an NDA?

Thanks,
Jonas

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 06:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MFA enrollment export + short-lived session token traces for SOC 2 review

On Mon, 24 Aug 2026 at 09:03, Jonas Weber wrote:
> Markus — can you confirm feasibility and estimated delivery (CSV + NDJSON + a short attestation paragraph / bridge letter draft)?

We can do this. Estimated scope/timeline: 2 business days to pull exports and produce initial redacted files, plus 1 business day for a compliance-signed bridge letter draft.

Deliverables we'll provide back to Jonas to forward:
- mfa-enrollment-export-2026-08-18.csv (fields: user_email_masked, device_type, enrollment_method, enrolled_at, last_used_at)
- session-token-trace-2026-08-18.ndjson (token_id, client_id, issued_at, ttl_seconds, refresh_event=true/false, user_masked)
- short attestation paragraph (TXT) indicating that during 2025-09-01 to 2026-02-28 the platform enforced MFA enrollment for console logins and required device attestation for WebAuthn where applicable; and that tokens with TTL <= 1 hour were issued for delegated service tokens per our auth policy.

Considerations:
- We will strip IP addresses and raw header values from the session trace unless Aurelia confirms they need them; auditors sometimes ask for IPs for correlation — if so we can provide an additional redacted column.
- For service_account client_ids that are used by customers (customer-owned service principals), we will not include secrets and will only surface client_id and token metadata.

I'll attach the working files to Laura's mailbox for review and signature.
-Markus

Attachments: mfa-enrollment-export-2026-08-18.csv (stub), session-token-trace-2026-08-18.ndjson (stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Nguyen <k.nguyen@aureliahealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MFA enrollment export + short-lived session token traces for SOC 2 review

Hi Kim — attaching the requested artifacts and a draft bridge letter (attached PDF).

Summary of artifacts attached:
- mfa-enrollment-export-2026-08-18.csv (user emails masked as j***@aureliahealth.com; full mapping available under NDA)
- session-token-trace-2026-08-18.ndjson (IP addresses redacted per our PII policy; contains token_id, client_id, issued_at, ttl_seconds, refresh_event)
- redwood-soc2-bridge-letter-draft-2026-08-25.pdf (short statement that the supplemental traces and enrollment exports are consistent with our SOC 2 Type II controls for authentication and session management for the period 2025-09-01 to 2026-02-28)

Notes / clarifications for auditors:
- The session trace extract uses token issuance timestamps in UTC. TTL is expressed in seconds.
- Service-to-service tokens (client credentials) are issued with a default TTL of 1800s (30m) unless a customer-specific configuration shortens it; refresh events are recorded when refresh endpoints are invoked.
- Device attestation is enforced for WebAuthn enrollments and for our SSO-backed device posture checks; the enrollment export includes enrollment_method to show whether WebAuthn or OTP was used.

If Jason (audit partners) wants direct access to the redacted extract in a secure S3 bucket and to a short walkthrough call, we can schedule that.

Kim — please confirm receipt and whether the redaction level is acceptable. If you want IPs or full emails, we'll need a written justification and an NDA amendment.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- mfa-enrollment-export-2026-08-18.csv (attachment stub)
- session-token-trace-2026-08-18.ndjson (attachment stub)
- redwood-soc2-bridge-letter-draft-2026-08-25.pdf (attachment stub)
